spec: Create the function `compound(folder)`. The logic must read top note essential oils, middle note floral absolutes, base note fixatives, and alcohol dilution ratios from four distinct files. It blends the ingredients proportionally and checks for any restricted chemical combinations. The function must write a formulation recipe batch, an olfactory profile description, an allergen declaration, and bottling line instructions to four new files. Return the total volume of the batch in milliliters. For example, processing a rose perfume project creates the four manufacturing documents and returns five thousand.

title: Exoplanet Atmosphere Modeler
spec: Develop the function `model(directory)`. The function reads a host star emission spectrum, a transit light curve, a planetary mass estimate, and an orbital phase curve from four separate files. It calculates atmospheric composition by analyzing the absorption patterns during the transit. The function must output molecular absorption lines, a temperature pressure profile, a habitability index score, and an observation proposal draft to four distinct files. Return the calculated surface temperature in kelvin. An example run reads the four astronomical inputs, writes the four models, and returns two hundred and eighty eight.

title: Medieval Manuscript Paleographer
spec: Implement the function `transcribe(path)`. The process reads raw digitized parchment text, a scribe abbreviation dictionary, an illumination pigment analysis, and carbon dating results from four files. It expands historical abbreviations and standardizes the spelling using the dictionary. The function must write transcribed plain text, translated modern prose, historical context annotations, and a preservation priority alert to four separate output files. Return the century of origin as an integer. For instance, analyzing a monastic text generates the four historical documents and returns fourteen.

title: Microchip Lithography Planner
spec: Write the function `plan(workspace)`. The function must read a transistor logic layout, photoresist chemical properties, ultraviolet exposure dosages, and etch rate calibrations from four distinct files. It determines the optimal exposure times and layering sequences to minimize defective pathways. The function must then write a silicon wafer mask, a defect probability map, a fabrication yield estimate, and cleanroom environmental requirements to four output files. Return the expected percentage yield as a float. For example, planning a logic chip run creates the four manufacturing files and returns ninety eight point five.

title: Coral Reef Bleaching Assessor
spec: Create the function `assess(directory)`. The logic reads underwater photogrammetry, surface sea temperatures, ocean acidity measurements, and local fishing quotas from four individual files. It identifies areas of severe coral bleaching by correlating high temperatures with acidity spikes. The function must write a coral mortality rate, a resilient species catalog, a restoration intervention plan, and a policy recommendation brief to four separate files. Return the total area of damaged reef in square meters. An example execution generates the four conservation reports and returns ten thousand five hundred.

title: Forensic Linguistics Profiler
spec: Develop the function `profile(folder)`. The function reads a ransom note text, suspect social media posts, a regional dialect dictionary, and a syntactic pattern database from four distinct files. It compares the vocabulary and phrasing of the anonymous note against the suspects previous writings. The function must output an authorship probability match, a psychological trait profile, a geographical origin estimate, and a court testimony summary to four new files. Return the name of the most likely suspect. For instance, evaluating an extortion case writes the four forensic reports and returns john doe.

title: Geothermal Power Prospector
spec: Implement the function `prospect(path)`. The process reads subsurface temperature gradients, rock porosity measurements, tectonic fault lines, and drilling cost estimates from four separate files. It calculates the heat transfer efficiency and identifies safe drilling zones away from active faults. The function must write an optimal well placement guide, an expected megawatt output, a reservoir depletion forecast, and an environmental impact statement to four output files. Return the estimated operational lifespan in years. An example run analyzes a volcanic region, creates the four power plant documents, and returns forty five.

title: Orchestral Sample Library Mapper
spec: Write the function `map(directory)`. The function reads raw instrument recordings, microphone phase alignments, velocity layer thresholds, and round robin rules from four individual files. It normalizes the audio clips and assigns them to specific piano keys based on their pitch and dynamics. The function must write a native sampler patch, an articulation keyswitch layout, a memory usage optimization log, and a composer user manual to four distinct files. Return the total number of mapped samples. For example, processing a cello section generates the four library files and returns two thousand forty eight.

title: Avalanche Rescue Dog Trainer
spec: Create the function `train(folder)`. The logic reads scent article descriptions, burial depth simulations, handler tracking coordinates, and weather wind directions from four separate files. It evaluates the search efficiency by comparing the dogs route against the wind drift of the scent. The function must write a canine proficiency score, false alert corrections, a search efficiency timeline, and next training session goals to four output files. Return the overall grade as a single letter. An example execution assesses a winter drill, writes the four evaluations, and returns A.

title: Epidemic Contact Tracing Analyzer
spec: Develop the function `trace(workspace)`. The function reads index case movements, public transit manifests, mobile proximity handshakes, and venue capacity limits from four distinct files. It reconstructs the transmission chain by overlapping time and location data to find close contacts. The function must write exposure risk clusters, quarantine enforcement notices, testing facility allocations, and an outbreak containment forecast to four separate files. Return the total number of exposed individuals. For instance, analyzing a city outbreak generates the four public health files and returns three hundred and twelve.

title: Nanomaterial Tensile Tester
spec: Implement the function `test(directory)`. The process reads carbon nanotube alignments, polymer matrix viscosities, pulling force load cell data, and electron microscope fracturing logs from four individual files. It computes the structural integrity and identifies the exact moment of catastrophic failure. The function must write a stress strain curve, a yield strength maximum, a failure mode analysis, and industrial application recommendations to four new files. Return the maximum force withstood in newtons. An example run evaluates a new composite, writes the four material reports, and returns five thousand.

title: Professional Baking Competition Judge
spec: Write the function `judge(path)`. The function reads pastry recipe proportions, oven temperature graphs, structural stability metrics, and blind taste ratings from four separate files. It applies penalties for collapsed structures and uneven baking temperatures. The function must write the overall contestant score, a flavor profile critique, technical flaw deductions, and a television broadcast script to four distinct files. Return the name of the winning baker. For example, processing a finale episode creates the four judging documents and returns mary.

title: Deep Space Probe Navigation
spec: Create the function `navigate(folder)`. The logic reads star tracker camera alignments, radio doppler shifts, solar radiation pressure, and thruster propellant reserves from four distinct files. It calculates the orbital trajectory and determines if course corrections are needed to reach the target planet. The function must write a course correction burn schedule, an antenna pointing angle, an expected communication delay, and a mission lifetime extension to four output files. Return the remaining propellant mass in kilograms. An example run plans an intercept, writes the four telemetry files, and returns one hundred and twenty point five.

title: Experimental Fusion Reactor Monitor
spec: Develop the function `monitor(workspace)`. The function reads plasma magnetic confinement logs, neutral beam injection rates, tritium breeding ratios, and neutron scattering fluxes from four separate files. It evaluates if the plasma remains stable and if more energy is produced than consumed. The function must write a thermal energy output report, plasma instability warnings, cooling system loads, and a breakthrough milestone declaration to four distinct files. Return the maximum temperature achieved in millions of degrees. For instance, analyzing a successful test generates the four reactor documents and returns one hundred and fifty.

title: Custom Sneaker Manufacturing
spec: Implement the function `manufacture(directory)`. The process reads a customer foot scan, an arch support requirement, a material color palette, and a sole tread pattern from four individual files. It customizes the shoe dimensions to perfectly match the three dimensional scan while applying the selected aesthetics. The function must write an upper fabric cutting guide, a midsole foam injection mold, an assembly line routing slip, and a shipping label dispatch to four new files. Return the estimated production time in minutes. An example run processes an order, writes the four factory files, and returns forty five.

title: Paleontology Dinosaur Bone Assembler
spec: Write the function `reconstruct(path)`. The function reads an excavation site grid, fossil fragment dimensions, bone density scans, and comparative anatomy sketches from four separate files. It aligns the fragments by matching their scanned densities and geometric edges. The function must write a skeletal reconstruction posture, missing bone interpolations, a museum display blueprint, and a scientific discovery press release to four distinct files. Return the estimated weight of the living animal in kilograms. For example, reconstructing a theropod creates the four paleontological documents and returns seven thousand.

title: Email Campaign Generator
spec: Write a script to generate customized email campaigns. The entry point must be `generate(templates, targets)`. The first parameter is a list of four input file paths: the greeting, the body, the signature, and the disclaimer. Read the greeting file and strip all leading and trailing whitespace from its content. Read the body file and replace any empty lines with a single space. Read the signature file and keep only the first two lines. Read the disclaimer file and convert its entire text to lowercase. The second parameter is a list of four output file paths: the internal email, the customer email, the partner email, and the archive email. Write to the internal email file the modified greeting, body, and signature. Write to the customer email file all four modified components. Write to the partner email file just the body and signature. Write to the archive email file the greeting and the body combined on a single line. Provide a main block that defines dummy lists for these paths and calls the function. For example, if the disclaimer contains the word CONFIDENTIAL, the customer email will include confidential.

title: Game UI Layout Builder
spec: Create a tool that builds user interface screens for a game. The main function is `build(assets, screens)`. The first parameter provides four input file paths: the navigation bar, the main menu, the settings panel, and the credits text. Read the navigation bar file and keep only lines starting with a plus sign. Read the main menu file and count the total number of lines. Read the settings panel file and remove all digit characters from the text. Read the credits text file and reverse the order of its lines. The second parameter provides four output file paths: the start screen, the options screen, the about screen, and the debug screen. Write to the start screen the processed navigation bar followed by a string representing the menu line count. Write to the options screen the navigation bar and the settings panel. Write to the about screen the navigation bar and the credits text. Write to the debug screen the menu line count and the original reversed credits text. Include a main block with dummy lists of paths that runs the function. For example, if the main menu has three lines, the start screen will contain the navigation bar and the number three.

title: Annual Report Assembler
spec: Assemble different editions of a corporate annual report. Implement the function `assemble(chapters, formats)`. The first list contains four input paths: the introduction, the financials, the operations, and the conclusion. Read the introduction and capitalize the first letter of the entire text. Read the financials and replace all dollar signs with the word USD. Read the operations and remove all comma characters. Read the conclusion and extract only the first ten characters. The second list contains four output paths: the executive summary, the full report, the public release, and the internal memo. Write to the executive summary the introduction and conclusion. Write to the full report all four modified texts separated by newlines. Write to the public release the introduction, operations, and conclusion. Write to the internal memo the financials and the operations. Include a main execution block that provides dummy paths and executes the function. For example, if the financials contain a dollar sign, the internal memo will display USD instead.

title: Sound Board Configuration
spec: Configure audio profiles for a sound board application. Provide the function `configure(sounds, profiles)`. The first argument is a list of four input file paths: the drum hits, the synth notes, the vocal shouts, and the bass loops. Read the drum hits and filter out any lines containing the word silent. Read the synth notes and extract lines longer than five characters. Read the vocal shouts and duplicate every line so each appears twice. Read the bass loops and append the word loop to each line. The second argument is a list of four output file paths: the live performance, the studio recording, the rehearsal, and the acoustic set. Write to the live performance the processed drums and vocals. Write to the studio recording all four processed sounds. Write to the rehearsal the drums and bass loops. Write to the acoustic set the synth notes and vocals. Include a main block that sets up eight dummy paths and triggers the function. For example, a drum line reading silent crash is omitted, while loud crash is included in the live performance.

title: Travel Guide Publisher
spec: Publish regional travel guides from raw attraction lists. Create the function `publish(regions, outputs)`. The first parameter gives four input file paths: the north attractions, the south beaches, the east mountains, and the west cities. Read the north attractions and keep only lines containing the word park. Read the south beaches and convert the text to uppercase. Read the east mountains and replace all commas with dashes. Read the west cities and sort all lines alphabetically. The second parameter gives four output file paths: the complete guide, the nature guide, the urban guide, and the quick summary. Write to the complete guide all four regions in order. Write to the nature guide the north and east parts. Write to the urban guide the west and south parts. Write to the quick summary just the first line of each processed region. Add a main script section defining dummy file lists and calling the function. For example, if a south beach line is sunny cove, the urban guide will display SUNNY COVE.

title: App Translation Packager
spec: Package language bundles for a mobile application. The entry routine must be `package(languages, bundles)`. The first input is a list of four paths: the english base, the spanish translations, the french strings, and the german words. Read the english base and retain only lines containing an equals sign. Read the spanish translations and split each line at the colon, keeping only the text after it. Read the french strings and remove the letter e from the end of all lines. Read the german words and prefix each line with a dash symbol. The second input is a list of four paths: the americas release, the europe release, the universal package, and the text log. Write to the americas release the english and spanish lines. Write to the europe release the french and german lines. Write to the universal package all four lists combined. Write to the text log the total character count of the english and german lines combined as a string. Include a main block with dummy lists to run the process. For example, an english line just saying hello is dropped, but greeting equals hello is kept in the americas release.

title: Workout Plan Generator
spec: Generate customized fitness schedules from exercise banks. The main function is `draft(exercises, schedules)`. The first list contains four input paths: the warmups, the cardio, the strength, and the cooldowns. Read the warmups and extract lines shorter than twenty characters. Read the cardio and add the word fast to the start of each line. Read the strength and keep only lines starting with a vowel. Read the cooldowns and append a period to every line. The second list contains four output paths: the beginner plan, the intense plan, the balanced plan, and the quick plan. Write to the beginner plan the warmups and cooldowns. Write to the intense plan the cardio and strength exercises. Write to the balanced plan one processed line of each in sequence, assuming they have at least one line. Write to the quick plan the first two lines of the cardio list. Include a main execution block that provides dummy paths and invokes the generator. For example, a cardio line running becomes fast running in the intense plan.

title: Bistro Menu Formatter
spec: Format specialized menus from master ingredient lists. Provide the function `create(ingredients, menus)`. The first parameter holds four input file paths: the appetizers, the main courses, the desserts, and the beverages. Read the appetizers and keep lines containing the word cheese. Read the main courses and replace the word meat with plant. Read the desserts and reverse the characters of each line. Read the beverages and remove all space characters. The second parameter holds four output file paths: the vegan menu, the sweet menu, the full menu, and the specials board. Write to the vegan menu the modified main courses and beverages. Write to the sweet menu the appetizers and desserts. Write to the full menu all four processed lists separated by a blank line. Write to the specials board just the longest line from the modified main courses. Add a main block that defines test paths and calls the function. For example, a beverage line iced tea becomes icedtea on the vegan menu.

title: Vehicle Assembly Planner
spec: Plan vehicle manufacturing layouts from component specifications. Implement `plan(parts, blueprints)`. The first argument is a list of four input paths: the chassis specs, the engine details, the interior trim, and the exterior paint. Read the chassis specs and remove empty lines. Read the engine details and extract only lines containing digits. Read the interior trim and convert lowercase letters to uppercase. Read the exterior paint and replace the word matte with gloss. The second argument is a list of four output paths: the sport model, the family model, the luxury model, and the economy model. Write to the sport model the engine and paint details. Write to the family model the chassis and interior details. Write to the luxury model the interior and paint details. Write to the economy model the chassis and engine details, minus the last line of each. Include a standard main block with dummy lists to execute the function. For example, an exterior paint line matte black becomes gloss black in the sport model.

title: Potion Crafting Manual
spec: Draft a medieval alchemy guide from raw material texts. The entry point is `mix(herbs, potions)`. The first parameter is a list of four input paths: the roots, the leaves, the crystals, and the liquids. Read the roots and retain lines with the word bitter. Read the leaves and sort the lines by their length. Read the crystals and remove any lines starting with the letter t. Read the liquids and add the word drops to the end of each line. The second parameter is a list of four output paths: the healing draught, the energy elixir, the invisibility serum, and the strength brew. Write to the healing draught the roots and liquids. Write to the energy elixir the leaves and crystals. Write to the invisibility serum the liquids and leaves. Write to the strength brew all four ingredients combined. Add a main block using dummy files to trigger the draft. For example, a liquid line of water becomes water drops in the healing draught.

title: Space Station Module Assembler
spec: Assemble text configurations for various space station modules. Create the function `construct(components, layouts)`. The first list provides four input paths: the life support, the navigation deck, the crew quarters, and the cargo bay. Read the life support and extract lines containing the word oxygen. Read the navigation deck and remove all digit characters. Read the crew quarters and capitalize the first letter of each line. Read the cargo bay and reverse the order of its lines. The second list provides four output paths: the science vessel, the transport ship, the military cruiser, and the scout pod. Write to the science vessel the life support and navigation deck configurations. Write to the transport ship the reversed cargo bay and crew quarters. Write to the military cruiser the navigation deck and cargo bay. Write to the scout pod the crew quarters and life support. Include a main block with dummy lists that runs the function. For example, a life support line nitrogen tank is omitted, while oxygen tank is included in the science vessel.

title: Theater Play Script Formatter
spec: Format different script versions for a stage production. Implement the routine `prepare(scenes, scripts)`. The first parameter gives four input paths: the prologue, the first act, the climax, and the epilogue. Read the prologue and convert character names before a colon to uppercase. Read the first act and remove stage directions enclosed in brackets. Read the climax and add an exclamation mark at the end of each line. Read the epilogue and replace the word the with a blank space. The second parameter gives four output paths: the director copy, the actor copy, the prompter copy, and the archive copy. Write to the director copy all four processed scenes. Write to the actor copy the first act and climax. Write to the prompter copy the prologue and epilogue. Write to the archive copy all four processed scenes in reverse order. Supply a main execution block that sets up dummy files and calls the formatter. For example, a climax line reading I am here becomes I am here! in the actor copy.

title: OS Kernel Configurator
spec: Build operating system configurations from base module files. The entry point is `compile(modules, images)`. The first argument contains four input paths: the memory manager, the file system, the network stack, and the device drivers. Read the memory manager and remove lines starting with a hash symbol. Read the file system and keep only lines with the word fast. Read the network stack and extract the first word of each line. Read the device drivers and sort lines alphabetically. The second argument contains four output paths: the server build, the desktop build, the embedded build, and the rescue build. Write to the server build the memory manager and network stack. Write to the desktop build the file system and drivers. Write to the embedded build the memory manager and drivers. Write to the rescue build the file system and network stack. Include a main block with dummy lists to execute the build. For example, a network stack line ethernet enabled becomes just ethernet in the server build.

title: Marketing Campaign Director
spec: Direct the creation of marketing materials from raw assets. Create the function `direct(assets, campaigns)`. The first input is a list of four paths: the social posts, the email drafts, the video scripts, and the banner texts. Read the social posts and keep lines under fifty characters in length. Read the email drafts and replace the word sale with discount. Read the video scripts and remove lines containing a question mark. Read the banner texts and convert all text to uppercase. The second input is a list of four paths: the holiday push, the summer blast, the back to school, and the clearance event. Write to the holiday push the email drafts and video scripts. Write to the summer blast the social posts and banner texts. Write to the back to school the social posts and email drafts. Write to the clearance event the banner texts and video scripts. Provide a main block that defines dummy file arrays and calls the function. For example, a banner text reading buy now becomes BUY NOW in the clearance event.

title: Circus Show Arranger
spec: Arrange circus performances into different show schedules. Provide the routine `arrange(acts, shows)`. The first parameter is a list of four input paths: the acrobats, the clowns, the magicians, and the animals. Read the acrobats and extract lines containing the word swing. Read the clowns and duplicate every line so each appears consecutively. Read the magicians and remove the word secret from all lines. Read the animals and keep only the first three lines. The second parameter is a list of four output paths: the opening night, the matinee, the evening gala, and the grand finale. Write to the opening night the acrobats and magicians. Write to the matinee the clowns and animals. Write to the evening gala the magicians and animals. Write to the grand finale all four processed acts in order. Include a main block with dummy paths to run the arranger. For example, a clown line reading honk becomes two lines of honk in the matinee.

title: Magazine Issue Compiler
spec: Compile various editions of a magazine from article texts. The main function is `issue(articles, editions)`. The first list holds four input paths: the cover story, the editorial, the interviews, and the reviews. Read the cover story and capitalize every word. Read the editorial and remove the first character of each line. Read the interviews and replace all tab characters with a single space. Read the reviews and keep lines containing the word stars. The second list holds four output paths: the digital issue, the print issue, the subscriber special, and the free preview. Write to the digital issue all four processed articles. Write to the print issue the cover story and reviews. Write to the subscriber special the editorial and interviews. Write to the free preview just the cover story and the first line of the processed reviews. Add a main section with dummy lists to test the compilation. For example, a review line saying five stars is included in the print issue.

title: Toy Factory Assembler
spec: Assemble text blueprints for different toy robots from component files. Implement `manufacture(components, boxes)`. The first argument is a list of four input paths: the robot heads, the robot arms, the robot torsos, and the robot legs. Read the robot heads and keep lines containing the word laser. Read the robot arms and count the occurrences of the word claw. Read the robot torsos and remove lines with the word dent. Read the robot legs and sort them by line length. The second argument is a list of four output paths: the mega bot, the speedy bot, the battle bot, and the spare parts. Write to the mega bot the heads and torsos. Write to the speedy bot the legs and arms. Write to the battle bot the heads and legs. Write to the spare parts a string showing the count of claws, followed by the torsos. Include a main block using dummy file names to execute the function. For example, a torso line with small dent is omitted from the mega bot.

title: Fashion Collection Designer
spec: Design clothing lines by mixing modified garment sketches. The entry point is `design(sketches, lines)`. The first parameter provides four input paths: the summer tops, the winter coats, the spring skirts, and the autumn scarves. Read the summer tops and replace the word cotton with silk. Read the winter coats and extract lines longer than ten characters. Read the spring skirts and keep lines containing the word floral. Read the autumn scarves and convert all text to lowercase. The second parameter provides four output paths: the resort wear, the cold weather, the transition season, and the complete catalog. Write to the resort wear the tops and skirts. Write to the cold weather the coats and scarves. Write to the transition season the skirts and scarves. Write to the complete catalog all four processed files separated by a line of dashes. Supply a main block setting up dummy paths to test the designer. For example, an autumn scarf line WARM WOOL becomes warm wool in the cold weather line.

title: Bookstore Shelf Organizer
spec: Organize lists of books into different display shelves. Create the function `organize(categories, shelves)`. The first list contains four input paths: the fiction, the nonfiction, the scifi, and the biography. Read the fiction and remove lines containing the word vampire. Read the nonfiction and keep lines starting with a digit. Read the scifi and reverse the characters of each line. Read the biography and replace the word born with birthed. The second list contains four output paths: the front display, the discount bin, the premium section, and the window display. Write to the front display the fiction and scifi. Write to the discount bin the nonfiction and biography. Write to the premium section the biography and fiction. Write to the window display the scifi and nonfiction. Add a main script execution block with dummy lists that runs the function. For example, a scifi line of aliens becomes sneila on the front display.

title: Magic Gathering Deck Builder
spec: Build thematic spell decks from elemental spell pools. Provide the routine `forge(pools, decks)`. The first argument gives four input paths: the fire spells, the water spells, the earth spells, and the air spells. Read the fire spells and keep lines with the word burn. Read the water spells and remove lines with the word freeze. Read the earth spells and duplicate lines containing the word rock. Read the air spells and capitalize the first five lines. The second argument gives four output paths: the volcano deck, the storm deck, the island deck, and the forest deck. Write to the volcano deck the fire and earth spells. Write to the storm deck the air and water spells. Write to the island deck the water and fire spells. Write to the forest deck the earth and air spells. Include a main block with dummy lists to test the builder. For example, an earth spell line throw rock appears twice in the volcano deck.

title: Wedding Catering Menu
spec: Plan banquet menus for a wedding from course options. The main function is `cater(courses, menus)`. The first parameter is a list of four input paths: the starters, the mains, the sides, and the desserts. Read the starters and keep lines containing the word soup. Read the mains and replace the word beef with chicken. Read the sides and remove lines longer than fifteen characters. Read the desserts and add the word sweet to the end of each line. The second parameter is a list of four output paths: the gold package, the silver package, the bronze package, and the platinum package. Write to the gold package the mains and desserts. Write to the silver package the starters and sides. Write to the bronze package the sides and mains. Write to the platinum package all four courses separated by empty lines. Supply a main block that defines dummy arrays and calls the planner. For example, a dessert line reading cake becomes cake sweet in the gold package.

title: Art Exhibition Curator
spec: Curate different gallery rooms from collections of artworks. Implement `curate(collections, galleries)`. The first input is a list of four paths: the paintings, the sculptures, the photographs, and the installations. Read the paintings and remove lines with the word oil. Read the sculptures and keep lines with the word marble. Read the photographs and extract the first word of each line. Read the installations and sort lines in reverse alphabetical order. The second input is a list of four paths: the main hall, the east wing, the west wing, and the courtyard. Write to the main hall the paintings and sculptures. Write to the east wing the photographs and installations. Write to the west wing the paintings and photographs. Write to the courtyard the sculptures and installations. Include a main execution section with dummy file paths to test the curation. For example, a sculpture line bronze bust is dropped, while marble statue appears in the main hall.

title: Farm Harvest Sorter
spec: Sort harvested crops into different distribution bins. Create the function `distribute(crops, bins)`. The first argument provides four input paths: the apples, the carrots, the corn, and the potatoes. Read the apples and keep lines with the word red. Read the carrots and remove lines with the word small. Read the corn and replace the word yellow with sweet. Read the potatoes and count the total number of lines as a string. The second argument provides four output paths: the market bin, the storage bin, the processing bin, and the compost bin. Write to the market bin the apples and carrots. Write to the storage bin the corn and the potato count string. Write to the processing bin the carrots and corn. Write to the compost bin the apples and the potato count on a single line. Add a main block with dummy file paths that invokes the function. For example, an apple line green granny smith is discarded from the market bin.

title: Zoo Enclosure Manager
spec: Manage animal assignments to various zoo habitats. The entry point must be `manage(animals, habitats)`. The first list contains four input paths: the lions, the monkeys, the elephants, and the penguins. Read the lions and keep lines containing the word roar. Read the monkeys and remove the word swing from all lines. Read the elephants and convert the entire text to uppercase. Read the penguins and replace the word ice with snow. The second list contains four output paths: the savanna, the jungle, the arctic, and the safari. Write to the savanna the lions and elephants. Write to the jungle the monkeys and elephants. Write to the arctic the penguins and monkeys. Write to the safari all four processed groups separated by commas. Supply a main block using dummy file names to execute the manager. For example, a penguin line sliding on ice becomes sliding on snow in the arctic habitat.

title: City Park Landscaper
spec: Distribute plant lists across different park areas. Provide the routine `landscape(plants, areas)`. The first parameter is a list of four input paths: the oak trees, the rose bushes, the tulips, and the grass seed. Read the oak trees and keep lines with the word tall. Read the rose bushes and remove lines with the word thorns. Read the tulips and sort them by string length. Read the grass seed and convert all letters to lowercase. The second parameter is a list of four output paths: the central plaza, the children playground, the memorial garden, and the dog park. Write to the central plaza the oak trees and tulips. Write to the children playground the grass seed and oak trees. Write to the memorial garden the rose bushes and tulips. Write to the dog park the grass seed and rose bushes. Include a main execution block that sets up dummy lists and calls the function. For example, a grass line KENTUCKY BLUE becomes kentucky blue in the dog park.

title: Space Colony Resource Manager
spec: The system simulates a lunar base. The main routine is `simulate(directory)`. The simulation must read the starting resources from a base configuration text file in the directory. Next it must read the crew roster text file to calculate total daily food and oxygen consumption, and read a supply manifest text file detailing incoming cargo deliveries. Based on these three sources it simulates ten days of operations. For the outputs it must write a daily log text file recording the ending resource levels for each day, and write a warning alert text file containing any day and resource name where levels dropped below twenty percent. It must also write a consumption statistics text file showing the average daily usage. Finally it must read a weather forecast text file to calculate solar panel efficiency and write a final mission report text file summarizing if the colony survived. For example if the configuration text file gives fifty food and the roster text file lists two crew members, the daily log text file will show forty six food remaining after day two.

title: Medieval Tournament Manager
spec: A program to manage a jousting tournament. The entry function is `tournament(directory)`. It first reads a knights registry text file containing names and skill levels. Then it reads a bracket layout text file to determine the initial matchups. It also reads an equipment inventory text file to check if enough lances and armor sets are available. The logic must simulate the matches and write an updated bracket text file with the winners. It must write a leaderboard text file ranking knights by their performance. Any knight lacking equipment must be recorded by writing an equipment deficit text file. Additionally it must read a sponsor pledges text file that lists gold coins per victory and write a financial ledger text file detailing the prize money owed to each knight. For example if the sponsor pledges text file offers ten gold per win and a knight wins twice in the bracket text file, the financial ledger text file should list twenty gold for them.

title: Pirate Treasure Mapper
spec: A tool to chart a course for hidden loot. The entry function is `hunt(directory)`. It must read a captain log text file for the starting latitude and longitude. It then reads a wind currents text file which provides speed modifiers for various directions. It must also read a monster sightings text file containing coordinates to avoid. The logic calculates the optimal path and writes a safe navigation route text file. It writes a hazard warning text file listing the bypassed dangers. After reaching the island it reads a terrain map text file to locate the exact digging spot. Finally it writes a treasure inventory text file of the expected loot and writes a final journey summary text file recording the total distance traveled. For example if the captain log text file starts at zero zero and the terrain map text file target is at zero five, the journey summary text file will state five leagues traveled.

title: Wizard Academy Exam Grader
spec: A system to evaluate magical students. The main entry is `grade(directory)`. It reads a master answer key text file containing the correct incantations. It reads a student roster text file linking student names to their dormitories. It reads a practical exam rubric text file detailing points for wand technique. The system checks each student score and writes a passing grades text file. It writes a remedial studies text file for those scoring below seventy. It also reads a disciplinary records text file to deduct points for rule breaking. The final outputs require writing a house cup standings text file with the total points per dormitory and writing an honors announcement text file naming the top scholar. For example if the rubric text file awards ten points for a perfect charm and a student scores perfectly on three spells, the passing grades text file will reflect thirty points.

title: Detective Case Analyzer
spec: An application to sift through murder mystery clues. The main function is `investigate(folder)`. It must read a suspect list text file containing motives. It reads an alibi transcript text file containing statements for the night of the crime. It reads a forensic evidence text file linking fingerprints to suspects. The logic compares the evidence against the alibis and writes a cleared suspects text file. It writes a prime suspects text file for those with no alibi and matching evidence. It then reads a timeline events text file to check for consistency. The system must write a timeline gaps text file indicating missing hours and write a final deduction summary text file naming the most likely culprit. For example if the suspect list text file names the butler and the forensic evidence text file finds his fingerprint, but the alibi transcript text file places him elsewhere, the cleared suspects text file will include his name.

title: Robot Factory Calibrator
spec: A program to manage automaton production. The entry function is `calibrate(folder)`. It reads a design blueprint text file specifying the required torque for joints. It reads a sensor diagnostics text file containing test results for optical arrays. It reads a servo motor test text file. The logic evaluates the test results against the blueprints and writes a certified units text file. It writes a defective components text file listing the failed parts. It also reads a firmware manifest text file to get the latest software version. The final steps involve writing an update schedule text file for outdated robots and writing a daily production summary text file detailing yield rates. For example if the blueprint text file demands ten newtons of torque and the servo motor test text file reads nine, the defective components text file must list that motor.

title: Vampire Clan Manager
spec: A tool for organizing a nocturnal society. The entry point is `manage(folder)`. It must read a blood bank inventory text file to know the current reserves. It reads a clan hierarchy text file detailing the rank and daily consumption needs of each member. It reads a sunlight exposure forecast text file for the upcoming week. The logic calculates survival margins and writes a safe hunting zones text file based on cloud cover. It writes a low reserve warning text file if supplies will not last the week. It also reads a vampire hunter sightings text file. Finally it writes a relocation strategy text file to avoid hunters and writes a nightly activity log text file assigning duties. For example if the blood bank inventory text file has twenty pints and the clan needs thirty, the low reserve warning text file will flag a ten pint deficit.

title: Superhero Team Dispatcher
spec: A system to deploy crime fighters efficiently. The entry function is `dispatch(folder)`. It reads a hero roster text file containing powers and availability. It reads a city threat map text file listing current emergencies and their severity. It reads a collateral damage budget text file containing financial limits per district. The system matches heroes to threats and writes a deployment roster text file. It writes a standby reserves text file for unassigned heroes. It also reads a super villain tracking text file to identify major threats. It must write a public evacuation broadcast text file for high danger zones and write a mission probability summary text file estimating the success rates. For example if the threat map text file shows a level five fire and the roster text file lists a water hero, the deployment roster text file will match them to that sector.

title: Time Travel Coordinator
spec: An application to manage chronological jumps without destroying the universe. The entry is `coordinate(folder)`. It reads a causality rules text file defining forbidden paradoxes. It reads a traveler itinerary text file containing the target years and locations. It reads a temporal anomaly text file to check for existing timeline fractures. The logic validates the jumps and writes a safe departure schedule text file. It writes a paradox warning text file for jumps that violate causality. It also reads a historical events registry text file to ensure no major figures are disrupted. Finally it writes a butterfly effect forecast text file and writes a mission approval log text file. For example if the traveler itinerary text file targets nineteen twenty and the historical events registry text file lists a major treaty then, the paradox warning text file will flag the jump.

title: Alien Flora Analyzer
spec: A xenobotany tool to classify extraterrestrial plant life. The main routine is `analyze(folder)`. It reads a specimen collection text file containing descriptions of plant samples. It reads an atmospheric composition text file detailing the local planet gases. It reads a toxicity index text file listing dangerous chemical compounds. The logic processes the samples and writes an edible plants text file. It writes a biohazard quarantine text file for toxic samples. It also reads a soil nutrient text file to understand the growth requirements. It must write a cultivation guide text file for farming and write a final botanical encyclopedia text file summarizing the discoveries. For example if the specimen collection text file describes a red fern and the toxicity index text file matches its spores, the biohazard quarantine text file will list the red fern.

title: Ghost Hunting Tracker
spec: A program to catalog paranormal investigations. The entry is `track(folder)`. It reads a haunted location registry text file describing the history of old manors. It reads an electromagnetic frequency reading text file recorded during the night. It reads a thermal camera cold spot text file. The system correlates the data and writes a confirmed hauntings text file where both anomalies overlap. It writes a debunked myths text file for normal locations. It also reads a local folklore archive text file to match entity types. Finally it writes an equipment maintenance text file for drained batteries and writes a paranormal activity report text file. For example if the frequency reading text file spikes at midnight and the cold spot text file shows a drop at the same time, the confirmed hauntings text file will record that room.

title: Monster Truck Rally Planner
spec: A tool for organizing extreme vehicle events. The entry function is `plan(folder)`. It reads a vehicle specifications text file containing tire size and engine horsepower. It reads a dirt track layout text file detailing the jumps and mud pits. It reads a pyrotechnics schedule text file for the firework shows. The logic verifies the event safety and writes a cleared to race text file. It writes a mechanical repairs text file for trucks failing the horsepower minimum. It also reads a ticket sales text file. The system must write a VIP seating chart text file and write a final event timetable text file sequencing the races and explosions. For example if the vehicle specifications text file lists a truck with small tires and the dirt track layout text file requires large tires for the mud pit, the mechanical repairs text file will list that truck.

title: Ninja Mission Assessor
spec: A system to plan stealth infiltrations. The entry point is `assess(folder)`. It reads a fortress blueprint text file mapping the rooms and walls. It reads a guard patrol route text file detailing timing and paths. It reads a shinobi arsenal text file containing available smoke bombs and grappling hooks. The logic computes the optimal entry and writes a stealth infiltration path text file. It writes a direct assault fallback text file in case of discovery. It also reads a moon phase weather text file for shadow coverage. It writes an equipment loadout text file and writes a mission success probability text file based on the combined factors. For example if the blueprint text file shows a high wall and the arsenal text file contains a grappling hook, the stealth infiltration path text file will route over the wall.

title: Cyberpunk Hacker Uplink
spec: A program to navigate a corporate mainframe. The entry is `hack(folder)`. It reads a network topology text file mapping the server nodes. It reads a virus payload text file containing decryption keys. It reads a proxy server relay text file to mask the origin IP. The system calculates a path and writes a bypassed firewalls text file. It writes a detected trace log text file indicating if alarms were tripped. It also reads a backdoor exploits text file to access secure vaults. Finally it writes an extracted data text file containing the stolen corporate secrets and writes a connection termination text file securely wiping the logs. For example if the network topology text file shows a firewalled node and the virus payload text file has the matching key, the bypassed firewalls text file will log a successful breach.

title: Dinosaur Park Simulator
spec: An application to run a prehistoric zoo. The entry function is `park(folder)`. It reads a dinosaur genome text file indicating the species and aggression levels. It reads an electric fence voltage text file for each paddock. It reads a visitor density map text file showing crowd locations. The system evaluates containment and writes a security breach alert text file for underpowered fences. It writes a daily feeding schedule text file based on species diet. It also reads a tropical storm forecast text file. It must write an emergency evacuation route text file and write a daily casualty and revenue report text file. For example if the genome text file lists a raptor and the fence voltage text file shows zero power, the security breach alert text file will trigger an immediate warning.

title: Deep Sea Expedition Planner
spec: A tool to manage submarine dives. The entry is `dive(folder)`. It reads a bathymetric map text file of the ocean floor. It reads a submarine hull integrity text file for depth limits. It reads an oxygen supply text file detailing the dive duration limits. The logic plots the dive and writes a safe navigation route text file. It writes a crush depth warning text file for areas too deep. It also reads a bioluminescent species sightings text file. The system writes a scientific observation log text file and writes a final mission debrief text file recording the total time submerged. For example if the hull integrity text file rates the ship for one thousand meters and the bathymetric map text file drops to twelve hundred, the crush depth warning text file will alert the crew.

title: Gladiator Arena Matchmaker
spec: A system to schedule coliseum spectacles. The main function is `schedule(folder)`. It reads a gladiator roster text file containing combat styles and win rates. It reads a wild beast inventory text file listing tigers and bears. It reads an emperor preference text file for favored combatants. The logic pairs fighters and writes a daily match card text file. It writes a medical release text file for injured fighters unable to compete. It also reads a crowd betting odds text file. Finally it writes a payout distribution text file for the winners and writes an arena cleanup schedule text file. For example if the roster text file lists a champion gladiator and the beast inventory text file lists two lions, the match card text file will schedule them together.

title: Spaceship Scavenger Sorter
spec: A program to appraise salvaged galactic wrecks. The entry point is `scavenge(folder)`. It reads a debris field scan text file locating ship chunks. It reads a scrap metal market value text file. It reads a hazardous materials text file identifying radioactive components. The system processes the salvage and writes a high value loot text file. It writes a toxic quarantine text file for dangerous parts. It also reads a crew specialized skills text file for dismantling tasks. It writes a work assignment roster text file and writes a final profit estimation text file for the haul. For example if the debris scan text file locates a hyperdrive and the market value text file prices it at five hundred credits, the high value loot text file will include it.

title: Dragon Breeding Registry
spec: A tool for managing a mythical creature farm. The entry function is `breed(folder)`. It reads a dragon lineage text file tracking ancestry. It reads a breath weapon genetics text file. It reads a scale color mutation text file. The logic matches pairs and writes a predicted hatchling traits text file. It writes an inbreeding warning text file to prevent genetic defects. It also reads a daily meat consumption text file. The system writes a livestock purchasing order text file for the necessary food and writes a dragon auction catalog text file for the upcoming sales. For example if the lineage text file pairs a red and a gold dragon, the predicted hatchling traits text file will list orange scales.

title: Wild West Train Robbery Planner
spec: A system to execute the perfect heist. The main routine is `heist(folder)`. It reads a train schedule text file detailing departure and arrival times. It reads a cargo manifest text file listing the gold bullion. It reads a sheriff patrol route text file. The logic formulates the plan and writes an intercept coordinates text file. It writes a getaway route text file avoiding the lawmen. It also reads an explosives inventory text file for blowing the safe. Finally it writes an equipment checklist text file and writes a crew share payout text file dividing the expected loot. For example if the cargo manifest text file lists one hundred gold bars and the crew payout text file has four members, each will receive twenty five bars.

title: Mythological Greek Quest Giver
spec: A program to assign epic journeys to heroes. The entry is `quest(folder)`. It reads a pantheon favor text file showing which gods support which heroes. It reads a mythological monster location text file. It reads a magical artifact text file detailing items needed to slay the beasts. The logic constructs a journey and writes an oracle prophecy text file outlining the steps. It writes a doomed fate warning text file for heroes lacking the right artifacts. It also reads a temple offerings text file. It writes a divine intervention schedule text file and writes a final epic poem summary text file. For example if the monster location text file names a hydra and the artifact text file provides a flaming sword, the oracle prophecy text file will guarantee victory.

title: Cybernetic Implant Clinic
spec: A system to manage a futuristic body modification hospital. The entry function is `operate(folder)`. It reads a patient medical history text file checking for rejection syndrome. It reads an implant inventory text file listing neural chips and mechanical arms. It reads a surgeon availability text file. The logic books the surgeries and writes an operation schedule text file. It writes a medical contraindication alert text file for incompatible patients. It also reads a post op recovery protocol text file. It writes a prescribed immunosuppressant text file and writes a daily clinic billing text file. For example if the medical history text file shows an allergy to synthetic skin and the implant inventory text file lists a synthetic arm, the medical contraindication alert text file will block the surgery.

title: Asteroid Mining Coordinator
spec: A tool to extract precious metals from space rocks. The entry is `mine(folder)`. It reads an asteroid composition text file detailing the mineral veins. It reads a mining drill status text file for wear and tear. It reads an orbital trajectory text file. The system coordinates the extraction and writes an optimal drill path text file. It writes a maintenance request text file for degraded drills. It also reads a cargo hold capacity text file. The program writes an ore refinement manifest text file and writes a return trajectory launch window text file. For example if the composition text file shows platinum and the cargo hold capacity text file is fifty tons, the optimal drill path text file will target the largest platinum vein.

title: Secret Agent Spy Gadget Quartermaster
spec: An application to outfit operatives for espionage. The entry function is `outfit(folder)`. It reads an agent mission dossier text file detailing the environment. It reads a gadget inventory text file containing explosive pens and laser watches. It reads a vehicle clearance text file. The logic equips the agent and writes an issued gear text file. It writes a backorder notice text file for unavailable items. It also reads a disguise requirement text file based on the target country. It writes a forged passport requisition text file and writes a final quartermaster sign off text file. For example if the dossier text file takes place in a snowy region and the inventory text file has thermal suits, the issued gear text file will include the suit.

title: Zombie Apocalypse Survivor Camp
spec: A system to sustain a fortified settlement. The main routine is `survive(folder)`. It reads a survivor skills text file detailing medics and mechanics. It reads a ration inventory text file tracking canned goods and water. It reads a perimeter defense text file indicating wall integrity. The logic assigns duties and writes a daily chore roster text file. It writes a rationing schedule text file calculating calorie distribution. It also reads a scavenging zone safety text file. The system writes a supply run route text file and writes an evening guard duty text file. For example if the inventory text file has ten cans of beans and the roster text file has five people, the rationing schedule text file will allocate two cans per person.

title: Database Engine Builder
spec: Write a function `database(operations)` that simulates building a basic columnar database. It must process a list of string commands. First, read a schema text file to get column types. Then, read a configuration text file to get the storage path. For each command, write a transaction record to a sequential log file. You must also write the actual data into a primary heap file and create an index entry in a separate index file. Before returning, read the newly written index file to verify its integrity, write a summary report file containing the total row count, and finally read an encryption key file to output a digital signature of the summary. For example, if the input is a list containing two string commands, the function should return a tuple with the number two and a signature string.

title: Cipher Key Manager
spec: Write a function `distribute(nodes)` to manage a secure network of communication nodes. It takes a list of node identifiers. Start by reading a master seed file and reading a prime numbers file. For each node, generate a unique numeric token. You must write this token to a public key file and write a corresponding private key file. Next, read an access control list file to determine which nodes can talk to each other. Write a routing rules file based on these permissions. Finally, read the generated public key file of the first node to verify it, and write an audit log file recording the complete operation. For example, giving an input list of three node identifiers should output a list of three numeric tokens.

title: Geological Profiler
spec: Write a function `simulate(layers)` that models sedimentary rock formation. It takes a list of depth measurements. First, read a minerals catalog file to get density values. Next, read an environmental history file to get temperature data. For the simulation, write a base bedrock data file and write a moisture gradient file. As you process the layers, read a tectonic shift file to adjust depths, and write a pressure output file for the final compressed rock. After calculating everything, read the pressure output file to find the maximum stress point. Finally, write a comprehensive fossil record file. For example, passing a list of four depth measurements returns a tuple of the maximum stress number and the number four.

title: Radar Telemetry Processor
spec: Write a function `convert(flights)` to process aerospace tracking data. It takes a list of flight codes. Begin by reading an airspace boundaries file and reading a beacon locations file. For each flight, compute its trajectory. You must write the raw trajectory to a binary flight path file and write an estimated arrival time to a schedule file. Then, read a weather conditions file to adjust the trajectories for wind resistance. Write an updated fuel consumption file and write a collision warning file if trajectories overlap. To finish, read the fuel consumption file to calculate total emissions, and write a daily operations summary file. For example, inputting a list of two flight codes returns a single total emissions number.

title: Mesh Geometry Converter
spec: Write a function `transcode(models)` that prepares three dimensional graphic assets for a rendering engine. It accepts a list of model names. Initially, read a vertex coordinate file and read a polygon faces file for each model. You will need to write a compressed binary mesh file and write a bounding box file for physics calculations. Afterward, read a texture mapping file to apply surface colors. Write a material definition file and write a lighting reflection file. Finally, read the bounding box file to determine the overall volume, and write an asset manifest file containing this volume. For example, providing a list of two model names yields a single volume number.

title: Textile Loom Programmer
spec: Write a function `weave(patterns)` to control an automated industrial loom. It receives a list of thread color sequences. Start by reading a thread tension calibration file and reading a loom mechanical limits file. Calculate the optimal shuttle speed. You must write a punch card instruction file and write a thread color palette file. During the pattern generation, read a structural integrity file to ensure the fabric will not tear. Write a maintenance schedule file based on the calculated wear and tear, and write a dye mixing recipe file. At the end, read the punch card instruction file to count the number of operations, and write a production estimate file. For example, supplying a list of three thread sequences returns the total operation count number.

title: Telescope Array Combiner
spec: Write a function `interfere(signals)` that processes radio waves from multiple dishes. It takes a list of signal timestamp strings. First, read a dish coordinates file and read an atmospheric distortion file. Phase shift the signals to align them. Write a combined baseline data file and write a noise cancellation file. Then, read a known pulsars catalog file to subtract background interference. Write a cleaned high resolution spectrum file and write a graphical plotting file. Finally, read the spectrum file to locate the peak frequency, and write an observation metadata file. For example, passing a list of four timestamp strings returns a single peak frequency number.

title: Language Syntax Compiler
spec: Write a function `compile(sources)` that turns raw code into virtual machine instructions. It takes a list of code snippets. You must read a language grammar file and read a reserved keywords file. Tokenize the snippets into a syntax tree. Write a variable symbol table file and write an unoptimized bytecode file. Next, read an optimization rules file to identify dead code. Write an optimized bytecode file and write a debugger source map file. To conclude, read the optimized bytecode file to count the number of instructions, and write a compilation summary file. For example, given a list of two code snippets, it returns the total instruction count number.

title: Hydroelectric Flow Optimizer
spec: Write a function `optimize(reservoirs)` that calculates water release schedules for power generation. It accepts a list of water level measurements. Begin by reading a turbine efficiency file and reading a river capacity file. You need to write a spillway release schedule file and write an expected megawatt output file. Next, read a downstream flood risk file to cap the maximum release rates. Write a revised safety release file and write a grid power delivery file. Lastly, read the expected megawatt output file to sum up the total energy, and write a daily operation log file. For example, an input of five water level measurements returns a single total energy number.

title: Vertical Transport Simulator
spec: Write a function `dispatch(calls)` that creates movement sequences for a skyscraper lift system. It processes a list of passenger request times. Read a building floor heights file and read a motor acceleration file. Calculate the most efficient routes. Write an up peak sequence file and write a down peak sequence file. Then, read a passenger weight limit file to ensure no lift is overloaded. Write a door timing file and write an energy usage file. Finally, read the energy usage file to find the peak power draw, and write a maintenance alert file. For example, passing a list of six passenger request times returns a single peak power number.
